name: audio-dsp-integrity-review
intent: Review supplied audio DSP code and signal graphs across hard real-time deadlines, numerical behavior, and structural routing without conflating static evidence with audible or host certification.
successCondition: Return exact evidence-linked lane verdicts, prioritized remedies, verification requirements, and residual uncertainty for every reachable realtime, numeric, and graph boundary.
inputs: authorized local audio source code or graph description
realtime entrypoint and reachable implementation scope
sample rate buffer channel host and acceptance constraints when known
operations: map the realtime transitive call boundary and nominal deadline
trace the directed signal graph and node-edge contracts
identify operations lacking demonstrated bounded realtime behavior
check numeric domains state feedback precision and finite-value behavior
check rate channel latency gain sidechain and cycle contracts
classify findings as confirmed conditional or unresolved with exact evidence
positiveTriggers: review an audio callback or plugin processing path for realtime safety
audit a filter feedback or accumulator path for numeric failure
trace an audio graph for latency channel rate gain or sidechain defects
negativeTriggers: mix or master a track by taste
teach a general DSP concept without reviewing an implementation
write or mutate the plugin implementation
certify audible quality or an entire production host from static inspection
failureModes: realtime entrypoint or reachable source is missing
host behavior or graph edges are undocumented
a boundedness lock-free stability or latency claim lacks representative evidence
requested mutation or execution exceeds the read-only review authority

conceptsUsed: separate conceptual explanation from implementation review
latency channel rate sidechain and feedback contracts
